public.text: The document does not reflect the federated governance models present in several European countries, including Italy, where national infrastructures such as the Fascicolo Sanitario Elettronico (FSE 2.0) rely on regional implementation and interoperability.
public.suggestedRevision: Add guidance on federated architectures so the framework is applicable in decentralised and regionally implemented national systems.
